Package ui

Class RestockReportPane

java.lang.Object
ui.RestockReportPane
public class RestockReportPane extends Object
Restock Report: every inventory row whose on-hand stock is under its minimum (the same rule that marks a row LOW in the Inventory tab). Read only. The emptiest rows are listed first.
